# 📄 The Field Guide Counter-Spec
**document** · shared · knowledge

COUNTER-SPEC-meet-and-overlay.md + REFLECTION-MAP.md — the reply to the ARWorld handoff, built as evidence rather than argued as prose: eight suites, 124 properties (meet-overlay 54/54 · 22-code rejection register 8/8 · zero-shared-code Python consumer 15/15 byte-exact · lab bridge importing DTG runtimes 07+01 10/10 · the reflection map itself checked 6/6). The correspondence table is executed, not maintained — a row whose property dies goes red. Found the hole in the lab: its formation runtime gates every edge on personhood, modelling only the community-anchored construction; the pairwise case had never been exercised.
> *The fastest way to disagree with any of this is a failing test.*

## Edges out

- *references* → [[the Hitchhikers Field Guide (ARWorld)]]
- *extends* → [[the Decentralized Trust Graph (DTG)]]
- *defines* → [[the Meet Rite]]
- *defines* → [[audience is granted, not computed]]
- *defines* → [[the pairwise peer reference]]
- *defines* → [[a wiki fork is not an audience]]
- *defines* → [[erosion is a rate, not a cliff]]
- *defines* → [[rounding is not a detail]]
